name: skip
text: A person happily skips forward in a straight line with a rhythmic step-hop, step-hop pattern. Step onto the left foot, hop on the left foot lifting the right knee, step onto the right foot and hop on the right foot lifting the left knee. Arms swing freely opposite the legs. Continue skipping forward with bouncy alternating hops, without stopping.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 左右腿交替踏跳、高抬膝，身体有明显上下弹跳，双臂配合平衡；不是普通走路或原地蹦跳。完整踏跳周期循环。
